children: Artelo Biosciences disclosed it was identified as below Nasdaq's new $5M MVLS threshold and is evaluating options to regain compliance.
Nasdaq's new rule requires listed companies to maintain MVLS of at least $5,000,000; failure may lead to delisting.
Artelo Biosciences was among ~180 companies initially identified as below the threshold; a temporary stay was later announced.
SEC published a proposed rule change to modify the operative date; comments due Oct 29, 2026; final timing/terms remain uncertain.
If rule applies, Artelo may consider capital raises, warrant or securities actions, expense management or other corporate measures to regain compliance.
